title: Grand Theft Auto Started as a Game Where You Played the Cop
hook: The first Grand Theft Auto began as a cops and robbers game called Race 'n' Chase, and publisher BMG wanted it cancelled before it shipped in 1997. Which GTA was your first?
script: Did you know Grand Theft Auto started out as a game where you could play the cop? Back in the mid nineties, a small studio in Dundee, Scotland called DMA Design was building a game called Race 'n' Chase. It was a top down cops and robbers game, and you could pick either side. The team soon noticed something. Nobody wanted to be the cop. Being the bad guy was just more fun, so the project shifted to the robbers. It was a rough project. The game crashed constantly, milestones were missed, and the publisher BMG Interactive wanted to cancel it. Gary Penn, who worked on the game, has said the turning point was a bug. One day the police AI went haywire and started trying to drive straight through the player. It was so much fun that the team left it in. Grand Theft Auto finally came out on PC in October of nineteen ninety seven. The studio that made it eventually became Rockstar North. Nearly thirty years later, Grand Theft Auto Six lands on November nineteenth. And this week Rockstar released a new single called Pusher and set the full score album by Justice for December eleventh.
